topic: Integral normalized composition series and Hanna's coefficient congruences
title: Proof of Hanna's OEIS A389474 formula (4) and extensions of Salerno–Silverman's (2017) integrality argument

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Paul D. Hanna's conjecture in OEIS A389474, formula (4), by extending Salerno and Silverman's (2017) integrality argument to implicit composition equations: the normalized solution of A(x^2+2x^3+2A(x)^2)=3A(x)^2 satisfies A(x)^(3k) congruent to A(x^3)^k modulo 3 for every k>=1. A triangular coefficient recursion with even numerators proves integral existence and rational uniqueness. A unit factor proves A389474 (3), the square congruence modulo 9; the same construction proves A389475 (4.a) and (4.b). Odd-parameter extensions and an alternative proof of the Salerno–Silverman prime-degree special case cover the reversion and iteration identities in linked entries A273095, A273320 and A274396. Every integral series also satisfies F(x)^(p^r k) congruent to F(x^p)^(p^(r-1) k) modulo p^r for primes p, r>=1 and k>=0.
summary: All-degree proofs of four conjectured congruences, integral existence, rational uniqueness and linked reversion/iteration identities; odd-parameter extensions, an alternative proof of the Salerno–Silverman prime-degree special case and a sharp standard prime-power congruence; finite checks through degree 96 for the original series and degree 30 for extensions.

related_prior_results.scope: Integral normalized prime-degree Böttcher coordinates; covers the A273095, A273320 and A274396 integrality cases after the stated substitutions.
Standard Frobenius and prime-power congruence lifting used in Corollary 10.

prime_power_congruence.statement: For integral F, primes p, r>=1 and k>0, F(x)^(p^r*k)-F(x^p)^(p^(r-1)*k) belongs to p^(r+v_p(k))*Z[[x]]; for k=0 the difference is zero.
prime_power_congruence.sharpness: For F=x+x^2, the coefficient at degree p^r*k+1 is p^r*k.

proof_scope: Written all-degree proofs of integral existence, rational uniqueness, the four original congruences, inverse-series identities, the Catalan comparison, both odd-parameter families, prime-degree and signed families, linked iteration identities and prime-power congruences. The four named Lean declarations concern the original congruences with normalized rational-solution existence.
